newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Nepline to buy three ships.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Nepline to buy three ships.

text.p: Malaysian shipping firm Nepline Bhd said on Friday it had entered into separate agreements to buy three ships for a total of about $12 million.

In a statement, it said the acquisitions involve a Cyprus cargo vessel with a deadweight tonnage (DWT) of 6,000 metric tonnes for $4 million; a Korean fuel tanker with DWT of 3,500 metric tonnes for $2 million and a German container vessel with DWT of 3,006 metric tonnes for $6 million.
It said the proposed acquisitions would be funded by internally generated funds and bank debt.
The acquisitions are in line with the company's strategy to expand its fleet size, with the aim of focusing on its chartering business, it said.
With the proposed purchases, the company will have a total deadweight of about 327,506 metric tonnes.
